betterquesting:10.desc:8:
As you might also have noticed when collecting gravel, blocks did not break.

This is intended behavior to preserve the beauty of lakes, rivers and mountains.

The following blocks will not break until at least a specific amount has been mined or certain quests are completed:

 * Gravel: 256 (at Y 61-63, skylight level at the top > 10)
 * Sand: 256 (same conditions as Gravel)
 * Water: 16
 * Clay: 512
 * Hardened Clay: 256

This ensures you have enough time to find alternative sources or materials to repair the landscape.
